title: Payment API latency increased
investigation: A slow transaction query was identified.
engineer_feedback: Check transaction-query indexes early for similar incidents.

title: Database connection exhaustion
investigation: Connection leaks were traced to an application path.
engineer_feedback: Do not treat pool size as the first fix when a leak is suspected.

title: Checkout requests became slow
investigation: A query plan showed a full table scan.
engineer_feedback: Compare query plans before changing application timeouts.
